This cutscene plays when the timer counts down to 0:00 before the game starts. The map has not yet changed, and the player's point of view is changed to a full screen third person view of the cutscene when the cutscene begins.
The following summarizes the events shown in the opening cutscene.
is situated in a discreet clearing in a forest.
are fleeing from a rural village the night of a total solar eclipse. They are being pursued by imperial and monstrous forces, such as

. While never stated in-game, the names of the Wave 10-15 and Wave 16 soundtracks imply that they are being persecuted for witchcraft. It appears that they have been running for quite some time, and they have been chased prior to the start of the cutscene. The sorcerer is already exhausted, and is desperately bent on their survival.

The sorcerer meets up with the woman and urges for her to flee while he buys her time, but the woman protests, insisting that she is unwilling to leave him. The sorcerer hurriedly tells her to meet up with him in the forest, when they are interrupted by a
that rounds the corner and begins to charge them. The sorcerer pushes the woman away and begins to fight the knight.
The woman runs into the forest, apparently not yet pursued. She runs, nearing collapse, when she encounters the

in the forest. Looking for a way to survive their dire circumstances, she approaches the cube and attempts to touch it, despite the increasing amount of pain and resistance she is encountering. After a difficult struggle, she touches the
, which begins to painfully transform her.
The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the opening cutscene.
The screen slowly lowers down the
shimmering with energy, placed in frame below a solar eclipse that is about to reach totality. Ominous music plays.
The screen snaps into view of a

running in the street with a panicked expression. He is dressed in a purple-black garb with gold outlining, and is stumbling as he runs, apparently injured and exhausted. He stumbles up an intersection, to face a
dressed in a purple dress, a white blouse and a red-gold tiara, and begins to gesture wildly.
I can buy you some time. But you need to get out of here, now!
I am not leaving you to deal with this alone.
I promise, I will meet up with you in the forest. But whatever you do, don't do anything until I-

The woman sprints away. The sorcerer clasps his hands together, and a high-pitched tone begins to ring as bright blue-white flames start to appear in his hands as the knight begins to run toward him.
The sorcerer thrusts his hands out toward the knight.
The frame shifts to the woman running alone in the dark forest, trying to escape. The frame expands as the woman gets closer to the dark purple treeline.

The frame again shifts to a close-up of the woman. She is panting, exhausted and sprinting through the forest as fast as she can. A moment later, she wheezes, stumbles and falls to the ground, gasping for air. Glancing up a moment later to try to continue her escape, she sees the
right in front of her and lets out a noise of surprise.
The ground in front of the
is cracked and molten, purple magma creeping out in veins around it. The

pulses with energy, purple energy lines marking the surface of the cube in a non-linear manner, drawn toward the center as if getting pulled in. The body of the cube is black and voidlike, and purple humanoids stick out of the surface erratically.
The woman, surprised, begins to walk towards it. Purple electricity arcs out of the

. She makes an effort to stand, but she is too exhausted to do so, and makes a half-step as she falls toward the The

The frame finally cuts to a landscape view of the larger forest with the

The woman awakens from the process. Collecting herself, she stumbles back towards the rural village she and the sorcerer had been fleeing from, preparing to use her newfound powers to defend herself and the
The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the first cutscene.
The screen shakes and zooms in on the
while it continues to violently glow and produce a pillar of deep violet. A violet-white blast of energy emanates out of the cube as the
absorbs its energy. A high-pitched sound is heard as the camera zooms in, before it snaps back and the energies of the
ultimately dissipate. The frame fades to black.

In a blurry filter, the frame focuses on the woman as she collects herself from what had just happened. She has been knocked to the ground from the transformation and the following blast of energy. She rises to her feet, breathing heavily and, partially disoriented, surveys her surroundings. Her clothes are now tattered, ripped and cut in several places, and the pupils of her eyes are now a gradient of violet and yellow. She appears to have recovered some of her energy. The ground maintains its appearance of purple magma, though the
appears to have disappeared, consumed by the woman.

The woman, having partially recovered, slowly begins to walk forward and out of the forest. The frame snaps to a landscape view of the rural village the woman and the sorcerer had been fleeing from. The woman walks into frame from the left as she faces the village. A short, high-pitched sound plays as the cutscene ends.
This cutscene plays a couple seconds after finishing Wave 16, as soon as the triumph dialogue box appears. When this cutscene ends, the match concludes.
The following summarizes the events shown in the opening cutscene.
who had been part of the forces pursuing the
is defeated. The woman stands over her felled foe, tired.

The woman hears the sounds of a struggle behind her and runs over to the source of the noise - the sorcerer, who had been tied up to a wooden pole. The woman frees the sorcerer and stands over him as he rises to his feet. He questions what had happened to the woman and she replies that she is unsure, but that she can protect the two of them with the powers she presumably gained her transformation.

The woman continues by stating that they will not run any longer and turns to walk away as the sorcerer follows. She remarks how she has a feeling that what had transpired was meant to happen, and the sorcerer affirms that he will remain with her regardless of what she chooses to do from this point.
The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the ending cutscene.
The screen fades to a close-up of a kneeling

, garbed fully in metal plate armor and a helmet that covers his face. He rasps once, clutching his chest, apparently mortally wounded. After a moment, he falls forward and lands on the ground with a heavy thud. The frame switches to a wider view as the woman steps back from the executioner, letting out a deep breath. Their encounter appears to have been in a village street, surrounded by houses on both sides.

The woman hears screams and other sounds of struggle behind her and after a moment's hesitation, rushes over to investigate. The frame focuses on the sorcerer, tied up to a wooden pole and struggling to break free from his binds.
(wriggling in an attempt to free himself)

The woman undoes the ties which bound the sorcerer. The sorcerer falls to the ground and the woman walks in front of him, standing over him. He gets back up and the frame closes up on him as he looks himself over, then turns to face the woman.
I don't know- But one thing's for certain: With this, I can protect the both of us.
She pauses briefly. Her voice is warped.
The woman begins to walk away and the sorcerer follows her, the frame switching to a backshot of the two.
Something tells me that... This was meant to be.
If that's the case... Whatever path you take, I will follow.

The woman and sorcerer continue to walk elsewhere as the frame begins to pan upwards and to the left. The solar eclipse, which has now reached totality, comes into view as the cutscene fades to black and ends.
